scenes.tts: You need yarn in four colors, cut into twenty pieces about five centimeters long. Mark out a patch of lawn about two meters square.
scenes.narration: You need yarn in four colors, cut into twenty pieces about five centimeters long. Mark out a patch of lawn about two meters square.

scenes.tts: While your child turns away, scatter all twenty worms on top of the grass. Say go, and give thirty seconds to hunt. Then count each color.
scenes.narration: While your child turns away, scatter all twenty worms on top of the grass. Say go, and give thirty seconds to hunt. Then count each color.

scenes.tts: The red and yellow worms usually go first. Green and brown ones are often left. Then try bare dirt or a rug.

items.text: Red and yellow usually go first

scenes.narration: The red and yellow worms usually go first. Green and brown ones are often left. Then try bare dirt or a rug.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child the whole time. Count every piece back and keep looking until all twenty are found, because pets can swallow loose yarn.

items.text: Find all 20 pieces; pets swallow yarn

scenes.narration: Stay with your child the whole time. Count every piece back and keep looking until all twenty are found, because pets can swallow loose yarn.
